# SimReady physics metadata fixtures

Original models: NVIDIA SimReady, licensed CC BY 4.0. Optimized GLB conversion:
CodePawl. These fixtures extract only source scene nodes and physics metadata;
mesh buffers, textures and visual material payloads are omitted.
